snippet.title: Jake Song Built an MMO Where AI Is a Player — Trying It Tonight
snippet.description:
Jake Song—the creator behind The Kingdom of the Winds, Lineage and ArcheAge—is back with Open MMORPG: a public, playable MMO experiment where human players and AI agents connect through the same protocol and follow the same rules.

The server cannot tell them apart.

I’m exploring the current build live and asking one honest question: **can AI agents make an MMO world feel alive—or only make it harder to know what’s real?**

📖 Read my full MMOlist story:  
https://www.mmo-list.com/articles/jake-song-open-mmorpg

🎮 Play Open MMORPG:  
https://openmmo.to.nexus

💻 Explore the OpenMMO repository:  
https://github.com/Julian-adv/OpenMMO

## Tonight’s plan

• Explore the world, combat, inventory and character systems  
• Test housing and item persistence where available  
• Look for the moment another character’s identity stops mattering  
• Keep a live **FEELS ALIVE / FEELS HOLLOW** ledger  
• Decide whether this is a game, a laboratory, or a public MMO design notebook

Open MMORPG is an early experiment, not a finished recommendation. Features, population and behaviour discussed during the stream reflect the build available on **22 July 2026**. I will describe what I can observe without pretending I know whether another character is human or AI.
